text: Pogačar's five-second cushion over Evenepoel could evaporate in a flat 26km ITT—individual time trials punish nothing but raw power and pacing, stripping away terrain advantages that have defined his dominance so far. Red Bull's internal dynamics become unavoidable today: Lipowitz sits just 1'48" back and will know his teammate's result before he starts, creating the kind of zero-sum moment that tests whether their fragile two-leader structure holds or fractures. Seixas, the French teenager breathing down the field in fourth, has shown he doesn't rattle easily, but a TT rewards experience and bike handling more than the aggression that's carried him this far. Watch whether Pogačar extends or whether the ITT's brutal honesty lets one of his shadows claw back the time they'll need in the Alps.
